extensionDescription.message: Organise Chrome tabs with your own LLM API.

settingsIntroduction.message: Choose the model Ark uses when you organise a window.

apiKeyHelp.message: Stored only in this Chrome profile.

baseUrlHelp.message: Use HTTPS, or loopback HTTP for a local model.

modelPlaceholder.message: Choose or type a model ID

modelHelp.message: Choose from the loaded list or type any model ID.

modelsLoaded.message: $1 models loaded. You can still type another ID.

privacyNotice.message: Tab titles and full URLs go directly to your selected provider. Ark has no server.

permissionDenied.message: Allow access to this provider, then try again.

unauthorised.message: The provider rejected this API key.

rateLimited.message: The provider limit was reached. Try again later.

requestTimeout.message: The provider took too long to respond.

networkError.message: Ark could not reach the provider.

invalidProviderResponse.message: The provider returned an unreadable response.

nothingToOrganise.message: Open at least two unpinned tabs to organise them.

sendingTabData.message: Sending tab titles and URLs to your provider.

organisedGroupCount.message: Created $1 tab groups; left $2 tabs ungrouped.

tabsChanged.message: Tabs changed while Ark was working. Run it again.

groupingFailed.message: Chrome could not apply every group. Your previous layout was restored where possible.
